svg.title: AVC Decoder Mode Main Data Flow
svg.desc: RTL-derived AVC decoder flow for codec_mode=1 and reg_avc_mode=1. It shows CCU admission, P16/P8 sequencing, spatial median MVP generation, candidate and MVD rendezvous, MV reconstruction, reuse of the existing MC interface, and accepted-result neighbor-cache commit.
svg.text: AVC Decoder Mode Main Data Flow
Active only when codec_mode = 1 and reg_avc_mode = 1 · current RTL in src_codec_dev
LANE 1 — CCU ADMISSION, TRANSACTION CONTEXT AND SCHEDULING
P16: one beat · P8: four beats
Payload is sampled on valid && rdy.
• no pending transaction and no held result
• command, candidate and MV queues empty
• legal ref_idx, partition and P8 order
P16 requires sub_idx=0; P8 must be 0→1→2→3
P8 beats keep the same base CU; Skip + P8 is rejected.
expected_sub_idx and base CU are retained
until the accepted MC result advances the sequence.
• P8 selects only the blk8 command lane
• P16 selects only the blk16 command lane
• visit active List0 refs from ref0 onward
sub0 → sub1 → sub2 → sub3 → MC lane0
A later P8 beat is not admitted until the previous beat
has reached MC and committed its final MV to the neighbor cache.
supported only on P16 in this RTL
held result blocks the next CCU transaction
Each accepted input therefore owns exactly one candidate/MVD join
LANE 2 — SPATIAL MVP PRODUCTION AND CANDIDATE/MVD JOIN
A/B neighbor SRAM · Col C · Ref List
P8 later beats reuse intra-CU A/B cache entries created
only after the preceding beat is accepted by MC.
Col/ref staging remains shared; the AVC median itself is spatial.
C uses B0 when available, otherwise B2.
missing inputs are zero-masked; one available source is forwarded;
The AVC path exits CAND_IDLE directly to CAND_DONE.
selected queue: blk8 for P8, blk16 for P16
• pending transaction and no held final result
• required cand0 reference slots are complete
• size, CU x/y and parsed ref_idx match
cand0 is the only decoder AVC predictor.
ve_mrg_top stays instantiated, but the top mux
selects the decoder result and masks its MC inputs.
LANE 3 — FINAL-MV RECONSTRUCTION, MC DELIVERY AND COMMIT
avc_mvpxy is zero at the implemented top/left zero-motion
conditions; otherwise it is cand0 MVP.
Simulation warns when the discarded sign extension differs.
Payload remains stable while MC applies backpressure.
The next CCU beat is blocked until acceptance.
No new MC port is introduced.
Acceptance is the architectural commit point.
• assert decoder cand_done on the selected MC lane
• update neighbor cache with final MV/ref/size/coords
• for P8: advance expected_sub_idx or finish at sub3
The commit makes the next P8 neighbor context valid.
CCU valid/payload → admission → selected-size neighbor/cand0 generation + parsed-MVD FIFO → context match → final MV → existing MC interface.
MC ack → result release + neighbor-cache commit; only then may the next P8 sub_idx be accepted. P16 is a single transaction.
Named nets are used between lanes to avoid long crossing wires; they do not imply extra RTL stages.
RTL basis: vc_mvp_top.v · vc_amvp_top.v · vc_mvp_ctrl.v · vc_mvp_get_neib.v · vc_mvp_cand_gen.v
